transcript:
**Agent:** Good afternoon! Thank you for calling TechSavvy Solutions. My name is Sarah. How can I assist you today?

**Customer:** Hi, Sarah. I’m having trouble logging into my account. It says my password is incorrect, and I can't seem to reset it.

**Agent:** I’m sorry to hear that you’re having trouble. I can help you reset your password. Can I have your registered email address, please?

**Customer:** Sure, it’s john.doe@email.com. 

**Agent:** Thanks, John. I’ll send you a password reset link right now. While I do that, is there anything else I can assist you with today?

**Customer:** Actually, yes. I noticed a charge on my billing statement that I wasn't expecting. Can you explain what it is?

**Agent:** Absolutely. Let me pull up your account details. It looks like you were upgraded to the Pro plan last month. Would you like me to provide more information on that?

**Customer:** I didn’t authorize any upgrade. I’m still on the Basic plan — I can't even afford the Pro plan right now.

**Agent:** I apologize for the confusion, John. That does seem like an error. I can revert your account back to the Basic plan and process a refund for the extra charge right away.

**Customer:** That would be great, thank you! How long will that refund take?

**Agent:** Usually, refunds take about 3-5 business days to reflect in your account. I’ll make sure it's processed today. 

**Customer:** I really appreciate your help! 

**Agent:** Of course! I’ve sent the password reset link and processed the refund for you. Is there anything else you need assistance with?

**Customer:** No, that’s everything for now. Thanks again for your quick help, Sarah!

**Agent:** You’re welcome, John! Don’t hesitate to reach out if you have more questions. Have a great day!
